_about: NFTT posts written from earlier pieces of the author's own: the platform and the date each original first appeared. Every NFTT post is a new essay, so this records the ORIGINALS, never a claim that the post itself first ran elsewhere. Only dates the post's own text states are listed, with that text quoted as evidence. Rendered into the byline by scripts/nftt_published.py stamp; checked by --check.
